in_sanskrit.name: Balak
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the power and strength to overcome obstacles and challenges, a boy

in_hindi.name: बालक
in_hindi.long_meaning: बल (bal) - शकति, बलवान (balavān) [power, strength] + क (kha) [and] + श (sh) [goal, end, achievement, success]

in_tamil.name: வல்லக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: வல் (val) [power, strength] + க (ka) [and] + ஷ (sh) [goal, end, achievement, success]

in_marathi.name: Balaksh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balaksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balaksh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bal' (strength) and 'aksh' (eye). This name signifies a strong, powerful individual with a keen sense of perception and insight.
